notes.md: - **RBI Governor:** **Sanjay Malhotra** – **26th Governor** of the **Reserve Bank of India**, took charge on **11 December 2024** for **3 years**; earlier **Revenue Secretary**; succeeded **Shaktikanta Das**.
- **Chief of the Air Staff:** Air Chief Marshal **Ashutosh Dixit** – **29th** CAS from **31 October 2026**, succeeding **Amar Preet Singh** (**28th** CAS, from 30 September 2024).
- **Cabinet Secretary:** **T.V. Somanathan** – since **30 August 2024** (succeeded **Rajiv Gauba**); given a **one-year extension** beyond **30 August 2026** (August 2026).
- **Chief Election Commissioner:** **Gyanesh Kumar** – **26th CEC**, took charge on **19 February 2025**, succeeding **Rajiv Kumar**; **Vivek Joshi** joined as Election Commissioner the same day.
